milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the cartography table (at spawn-relative [0, 1, 6]) and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The cartography table is in the center of the front room, 6 blocks from spawn along the Z axis.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the oak door (at spawn-relative [0, 1, 10]) in the dividing wall and face it. The oak door is 10 blocks from spawn along the Z axis, naturally encountered after passing the cartography table at Z=6.
